domain: Underground environments and original fantasy sourcebook library
contributionSummary: Owns underground environmental topology, voids, constructed spaces, environmental state, provenance, and dungeon-specific simulation. Maintains an original fantasy sourcebook library. Contributes domain knowledge and integration evidence to SURPS-owned Dungeons and Underground and Dwarven Strongholds books without absorbing SURPS ontology, inhabitant behavior, or campaign continuity.

blockers: All six declared Dungeon-owned books have canonical descriptors and distinct covers, but their ownership claims remain pending independent SURPS review.
The SURPS reviewer must reconcile contributor and ownership records, then verify the final development-branch manifest and catalogue snapshot before active admission.
